hard_release_blockers_policy: Any unresolved CRITICAL or HIGH item permanently blocks public release and scientific certification.

blockers.title: Future Information Leakage / Lookahead in Ingestion
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F3/R24 detected timestamp parsing vulnerabilities and potential lookahead in feature computation.
blockers.required_resolution: Enforce strict ISO-8601 UTC time contract, immutable issue-time sealing, and zero-lookahead assertion tests in backend/tests/test_v3_time_contract.py.

blockers.title: Model Authority Conflict / Legacy Baseline Fallback
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F1/R1 identified that ModelIntegrationService() could silently fall back to legacy Day-4 baseline if V3 path failed.
blockers.required_resolution: Eliminate implicit fallback. Failure to load V3 model must fail closed with MODEL_NOT_READY and set is_certified=false.

blockers.title: Fraudulent Hazard Specialist Claims in Public Documentation
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F10/R10 found documentation claiming 6 trained ML specialists when only formula heuristics existed.
blockers.required_resolution: Re-label all 6 hazard specialists as EXPERIMENTAL_FORMULA_BASELINE across README, API metadata, and frontend badges.

blockers.title: Uncalibrated Raw Margins Delivered as Probabilities
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F4/R4 found raw booster logits were used without isotonic transformation in early versions.
blockers.required_resolution: Pipeline must strictly chain LightGBM booster into Isotonic Calibrator and verify ECE <= 0.0500 on held-out test data.

blockers.title: Silent Corruption of Missing Cycles into Hardcoded Zeros
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F5/R24 found that missing previous cycles resulted in revision features being filled with 0.0 without flags.
blockers.required_resolution: Construct durable on-disk SQLite revision store that tracks forecast cycles and raises MISSING_CYCLE state when history is absent.

blockers.title: Conflation of Mock Secondary Provider with Full Ensemble Spread
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F12/R42 noted that dual-provider disagreement was at risk of being labeled as ensemble spread.
blockers.required_resolution: Explicitly label secondary provider as MOCK_FIXTURE_ADAPTER and decouple disagreement from ensemble spread feature inputs.

blockers.title: Geographic Scope Inflation Beyond 25 Verified Benchmark Stations
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F9/R41 noted that users could query any global coordinates and receive a 'CERTIFIED' badge.
blockers.required_resolution: CertificationPolicy must strictly whitelist 25 IMD surface stations and return is_certified=false / UNVERIFIED for any coordinate > 0.2 degrees from a benchmark station.

blockers.title: Frontend Lead-Horizon Presentation Beyond 240 Hours
blockers.evidence: Forensic audit F6/R36 found UI dropdowns with 16-day / 384-hour selections that had no empirical verification.
blockers.required_resolution: Restrict UI horizon dropdown to 10 daily horizons (24h to 240h) and verify with Vitest tests that >240h options are purged.

blockers.title: Abstention Trade-off Inversion on Out-Of-Time Benchmark
blockers.evidence: Investigation during R31 audit revealed that Phase 3_75 abstention metrics reported retained Brier (0.0661) higher than abstained Brier (0.0517).
blockers.required_resolution: Enforce mathematically consistent selective abstention policy where filtering out high uncertainty strictly reduces retained Brier score (0.0653 vs 0.0667 abstained).
